name: Moonspray
summary: Moonspray carries travelers between Darkshore and Teldrassil. The Alliance transport sails across the waters separating mainland Kalimdor from the great World Tree.

sections.title: A Vital Island Ferry
sections.body: Moonspray sails between Auberdine and Rut'theran Village. Across the Veiled Sea, the vessel carries adventurers, couriers, and provisions between Darkshore's coast and the night elf sanctuary at Teldrassil's crown.

faq.answer: Moonspray sails between Auberdine, on Darkshore's coast, and Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who owns and operates this ship?
faq.answer: Moonspray belongs to the night elves and sails with the Kaldorei Fleet under the Alliance banner.

faq.q: Why is this ferry route important?
faq.answer: Teldrassil rises from an island off Kalimdor's northwestern coast. Ships like Moonspray carry troops, provisions, and travelers across the water to the mainland.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Teldrassil to explore the wider world, you may make your first journey to the mainland aboard Moonspray.
For the Alliance, Moonspray links its main coastal hub in northern Kalimdor with Darnassus, the isolated capital.
